mapper.update: UPDATE dms_order_finance SET order_no = #{finance.orderNo}, pay_amount = #{finance.payAmount}, refund_amount = #{finance.refundAmount}, net_pay_amount = #{finance.netPayAmount}, product_cost = #{finance.productCost}, bonus_amount = #{finance.bonusAmount}, company_share_amount = #{finance.companyShareAmount}, company_profit = #{finance.companyProfit}, risk_status = #{finance.riskStatus}, remark = #{finance.remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{finance.orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order scoped_order WHERE scoped_order.id = dms_order_finance.order_id AND COALESCE(scoped_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId})
mapper.sql:
SELECT profit.*, CASE WHEN (profit.fully_refunded = 1 AND (profit.bonus_amount > 0 OR profit.company_share_amount > 0)) OR profit.company_profit < 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_finance_risk_rule rule WHERE rule.rule_code = 'BONUS_PAYOUT_RATE_MAX' AND rule.enabled = 1 AND profit.merchandise_revenue > 0 AND ROUND(profit.bonus_amount / NULLIF(profit.merchandise_revenue, 0), 8) > rule.threshold_value) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_finance_risk_rule rule WHERE rule.rule_code = 'PROFIT_RATE_MIN' AND rule.enabled = 1 AND profit.net_pay_amount > 0 AND ROUND(profit.company_profit / NULLIF(profit.net_pay_amount, 0), 8) < rule.threshold_value) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS risk_status FROM ( SELECT net.*, CASE WHEN net.fully_refunded = 1 THEN 0 ELSE net.net_pay_amount - net.net_product_cost - net.bonus_amount - net.company_share_amount END AS company_profit FROM ( SELECT ledger.*, ledger.pay_amount - ledger.refund_amount AS net_pay_amount, CASE WHEN ledger.pay_amount > 0 AND ledger.refund_amount >= ledger.pay_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fully_refunded, GREATEST(ledger.product_base - ledger.product_refund_amount, 0) AS merchandise_revenue, CASE WHEN ledger.product_base > 0 AND ledger.product_refund_amount >= ledger.product_base THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(ledger.product_cost - ledger.reversed_cost, 0) END AS net_product_cost FROM ( SELECT finance.order_id, shop_order.pay_time, COALESCE(finance.pay_amount, 0) AS pay_amount, COALESCE(finance.product_cost, 0) AS product_cost, GREATEST(COALESCE(shop_order.total_amount, 0) - COALESCE(shop_order.discount_amount, 0), 0) AS product_base, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(refund.refund_amount) FROM dms_finance_refund refund WHERE refund.order_id = finance.order_id), 0) AS refund_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(refund.product_refund_amount) FROM dms_finance_refund refund WHERE refund.order_id = finance.order_id), 0) AS product_refund_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN commission.status IN (2, 3) THEN 0 WHEN commission.status = 1 THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(commission.commission_amount, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(clawback.clawback_amount) FROM dms_commission_clawback clawback WHERE clawback.commission_record_id = commission.id AND clawback.tenant_id = #{tenantId}), 0), 0) ELSE COALESCE(commission.commission_amount, 0) END) FROM dms_commission_record commission WHERE commission.order_id = finance.order_id AND commission.tenant_id = #{tenantId}), 0) AS bonus_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(share.share_amount) FROM dms_order_company_share share WHERE share.order_id = finance.order_id), 0) AS company_share_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(item.coupon_cost_refund_amount, COALESCE(order_item.cost_amount, 0) * item.refund_quantity)) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id INNER JOIN dms_shop_order_item order_item ON order_item.id = item.order_item_id WHERE item.order_id = finance.order_id AND sale.apply_type IN (1, 2, 4) AND sale.status = 1), 0) AS reversed_cost FROM dms_order_finance finance INNER JOIN dms_shop_order shop_order ON shop_order.id = finance.order_id WHERE COALESCE(shop_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} AND shop_order.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND shop_order.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
) ledger ) net ) profit
